{"action":"done","summary":"All 4 acceptance_public.py tests pass. The existing implementation in tinydb/journal.py satisfies requirements R01-R08:

- R01: apply(operations) processes insert/remove operations, returns inserted IDs, raises ValueError on malformed ops
- R02: Atomic batch via _simulate() which reads current state, validates all ops, then writes; rollback on error preserves pre-batch data
- R03: Uses deepcopy for documents, ordinary TinyDB reads/writes work alongside BatchWriter
- R04: Rejects bool as doc_id via `type(ident) is not int`, validates operation structure (correct fields, list input, dict ops, dict documents)
- R05: preview() returns inserted IDs without committing changes or consuming tokens
- R06: Reads fresh from storage on each call, no stale snapshot caching
- R07: Idempotency token support - repeating identical batch/token returns cached result, different ops raise ValueError, failed batches don't consume tokens
- R08: Token bookkeeping stored in self.tokens dict on BatchWriter instance, never in user documents"}
